description: Fetches a feed of entities (companies) that were recently updated in the Norwegian business registry. Useful for monitoring changes to specific companies or watching for new registrations / status changes. Each update references the changed entity by orgnr along with the change type and timestamp.

dato.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — return updates from this point onward (e.g. '2026-04-20T00:00:00Z')

oppdateringsid.description: Continue from a specific update id (pagination cursor)

name: get_recent_updates
title: Get recently updated companies
